about: Replay of the 2026-10-30 stand-in-parser run (p0) at its late send-back: S1 is done (built, tested, documented, reviewed, committed); S2 was built, and its test stage sent the item back because the plan records a text search (rg over the docstrings) as a focused command, which prints no test IDs or counts. The amendment must keep S1 exactly and record that search as a check.
fault: The plan records an rg search of the docstrings as a focused command; a search prints no test IDs or counts, so a test stage can never pass it.
